standard.summary: YOLO 训练每隔多少轮存一次 checkpoint。-1 表示沿用 ultralytics 默认行为（只存 best/last）。
standard.effect: 只有大于 0 的值才会作为 save_period 传给 ultralytics；0 与负数都不下发。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练需要中途取权重复现某个阶段时。
standard.avoidWhen: 磁盘紧张时——按间隔存会在权重目录里留下大量 epoch 快照。

standard_en.summary: How often YOLO training writes a checkpoint. -1 keeps the ultralytics default (only best/last).
standard_en.effect: Only values greater than 0 are forwarded as save_period; zero and negatives are not sent at all.
standard_en.whenToUse: For a long run where you want to pull a mid-training weight to reproduce a stage.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When disk is tight -- interval saves leave a pile of epoch snapshots in the weights directory.

advanced.principle: router 先用 save_period or save_every_n_epochs 归一到一个值，默认 -1；entry_yolo 只在 int 值 > 0 时写进 train_kwargs，因此 0 / -1 都落回 ultralytics 自己的默认。
advanced.intervention: 请求归一化 + worker kwargs 组装两处，都不改训练循环。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响磁盘占用与恢复点数量，不影响训练速度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 LoRA 侧的 save_every_n_epochs 不是同一个键，也不共用目录策略。

advanced_en.principle: The router normalises save_period or save_every_n_epochs to one value defaulting to -1; entry_yolo writes it into train_kwargs only when the int is > 0, so both 0 and -1 fall back to ultralytics' own default.
advanced_en.intervention: Request normalisation plus worker kwargs assembly; the training loop is untouched.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Affects disk usage and the number of restore points only, not training speed.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It is not the same key as the LoRA-side save_every_n_epochs and does not share its directory policy.
